personalInfo.name: Preetam Prajapat
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Software developer with over 4 years of hands-on experience designing, developing and maintaining robust web applications. Proficient in leveraging React.js ecosystem tools and libraries to build scalable, responsive user interfaces, and skilled in integrating with backend services and databases to deliver end-to-end solutions.

notes.skills: Grouped by the problem each tool solves.
notes.experience: Two companies, one craft — building interfaces that stay fast as the feature list grows.
notes.projects: From internal admin dashboards to a public expense tracker — each one shipped end to end.
notes.certifications: Certified in React, still shipping in React.

skills.note: Where I spend most of my day — component architecture, routing and rendering.
Enough server-side work to design an API instead of just consuming one.
Keeping shared state predictable as screens multiply.
Layouts that hold up from a 360px phone to a widescreen display.
Live data that updates without making the page feel like it is blinking.
Schema design and queries behind the dashboards and portals I build.
Branching, review and release habits that keep a team moving.

description: Developed multiple web applications using React.js with Vite for fast, scalable front-end development.
Converted wireframes into responsive, high-performance UI components.
Integrated RESTful APIs with Redux and Context API for state management.
Optimized code for performance, reusability and cross-browser compatibility.
Integrated frontend components with backend APIs for seamless data flow.
Managed application state using Redux and Context API.
Optimized performance and scalability with modern frontend technologies.
Delivered features on schedule within Agile workflows.

projects.title: NWAY Career Portal
description: Developed a career portal web application from scratch using React.js with Vite.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs to manage job listings, applications and user data dynamically.
Implemented scalable state management with Redux for complex user interactions and workflows.
Delivered a responsive, high-performance interface optimized through Vite's fast build and development environment.

projects.title: FinTrack - Expense Management System
description: Built a web and mobile app to track daily expenses and income.
Used Firebase for real-time database and data synchronization.
Implemented monthly expense tracking with data visualization charts.
Designed responsive and user-friendly interfaces.

projects.title: Sales - Real Estate
description: Developed a sales real estate web application from scratch using React.js with Vite.
Integrated RESTful APIs for dynamic data handling.
Implemented state management with Redux for scalability.
Delivered a responsive and high-performance user interface.

projects.title: Opinion Trading Admin Panel
description: Developed the Opinion Trading admin panel using React.js, Bootstrap, Apex Charts and Socket.IO.
Built an intuitive, responsive dashboard accessible across all devices.
Implemented real-time data visualization with Apex Charts.
Integrated Socket.IO for instant opinion trading data synchronization.

projects.title: Bridal Dresses
description: Developed a bridal dress rental web app using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
Designed responsive, accessible UI components for an enhanced user experience.
Implemented and managed user and admin workflows for a seamless app experience.
Used Redux Toolkit to reduce boilerplate and improve maintainability.

projects.title: Event Bus
description: Created a web app for booking event transport using React.js, Material UI and custom components.
Designed the flow for picking customers up from stations and dropping them at event locations.
Ran usability tests, analysed user feedback and applied recommendations to improve navigation.

highlights: Awarded for participating in the Spandan 2K24 event as a volunteer.
